items.item_text: Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus three (3) years of related experience/training. Related experience: supporting C-suite executives in large, complex corporate environments.
Seven (7) years of related experience, education/training,

Full suite of administrative support for the Health Campus Development department, the CAO, & the Director (calendar & coordination, meeting management, proactively resolve calendar conflicts, event planning, travel support, department & division communications, etc), financial management support (budget report reviews, PO maintenance, non-labor submissions), labor resource management (timekeeping, productivity reviews, people planning, interview coordination, org chart maintenance), external department liaison (HR, IT/IS, Payroll, Supply Chain, operational clinical leaders, etc), and general business support (fleet maintenance, supply logistics, space setup, etc).

Support the general needs of the Health Campus Development department and help staff achieve their goals & objectives and support local operations, including long-term efforts to identify, assess, track, and implement efficiencies in operations (labor & non-labor); support a system-framework with a renewed and structured focus on quality, timeliness, and customer service; collaborate with administrative partners (Supply Chain, Finance, HR, IS,) for the benefit of all; and, provide analytic support across local operations.

Provide operational support across the department, including daily engagement, weekly reporting tools and escalation techniques, monthly scorecard reporting, performance reporting, and organizational collaboration support.
Partner with Facilities Planning, Design, and Construction teams and Campus Project Management in all ways aligned with the full suite of administrative support.
Perform surveys and studies in support of quality improvements related to project execution and resource management.
Operational improvement project-based coordination and co-management with internal partners and external departments (THT, OEC, Finance, Campus, etc).
Organizing, designing, and drafting organizational website content.
Manage, plan, and administer a range of administrative operations with intent to drive department-wide alignment and organization with established tools, structure, standards, and best practices.
Special projects, as assigned.
OR
Full proficiency in relevant software tools including Outlook, Teams, Sharepoint, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. Comfort and interest in learning new tools as needed.
Calendaring and managing multi-organizational meetings.
Political acumen and sensitivities to the differing perspectives and political circumstances within all levels of the organization as well as the Office of the President and external constituencies.
Strong service orientation.
Familiarity with the organization's processes, protocols and procedures.
Knowledge of federal regulations such as FERPA.
Thorough knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Solid analytical / problem-solving skills.
Strong skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff, faculty, alumni / donors, students and external constituencies, both verbally and in writing.
Advising and counseling skills.
Ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Ability to use high-level discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality.
Solid skills in problem identification.
